interface.signature: def search_substr(fullText: str, searchText: str, allowOverlap: bool) -> int:

preconditions.expression: isinstance(fullText, str) and isinstance(searchText, str) and isinstance(allowOverlap, bool)
preconditions.description: fullText and searchText must be strings, and allowOverlap must be a boolean.
If searchText is empty, the function must return 0 (handled in postconditions).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(fullText) - len(searchText) + 1) if fullText[i:i+len(searchText)] == searchText and (allowOverlap or i == 0))
postconditions.description: The return_value is the count of non-overlapping (if allowOverlap is False) or overlapping (if allowOverlap is True) occurrences of searchText in fullText. Overlaps are only counted if allowOverlap is True.
If searchText is empty, return_value is 0. Otherwise, return_value is a non-negative integer.
